ticket_number_extraction.description: 7-digit ticket number appears after 'TICKET#:' near the top of the ticket.

notes.ticket_number: 7-digit number on the line beginning with 'TICKET#:'. Label variants include 'Ticket No.' and 'TICKET #'.
notes.date: Date is on the 'Date/Time:' line in format M/DD/YYYY HH:MM. Extract date portion only (M/DD/YYYY).
notes.material: Product line contains a code followed by a dash and description (e.g. '0446FS - 4000 PSI WITH 25% SL'). Strip the leading code and dash; store the description text in Helper Notes.
notes.slump: Value after 'Slump on arrival:'. Leave null/blank if field is empty or absent.
notes.qty_delivered: Use 'Qty This Load:' as the per-load cubic yards delivered. Units are CY.
notes.excel_columns: A=Ticket Date, B=Logged Date, C=Supplier, D=Slump, E=Qty Delivered (CY), F=Ticket #, G=Helper Notes (material description), H=Human Notes (leave blank)
